name: Kaiser Permanente
why: Largest integrated health system (~12.6M members in catalog); kp.org medical bills with guest pay.

name: Quest Diagnostics
why: Largest U.S. lab company; national patient-billing site.

name: Labcorp
why: Second national lab company; Labcorp Patient portal and guest bill pay.

name: AdaptHealth
why: Largest home medical equipment provider (~4M patients); distinctive mandatory AutoPAY policy.

name: Lincare
why: National home oxygen/respiratory provider (~540K patients); Patient Portal with guest pay.

name: Apria
why: National home medical equipment / CPAP supplier (~280K); epay.apria.com billing.

name: DaVita Kidney Care
why: Largest U.S. dialysis provider; InstaMed patient payment portal.

name: Mass General Brigham
why: Major academic health system; one combined Patient Gateway (MyChart) bill across its hospitals.

name: Cleveland Clinic
why: Nationally known health system; main-campus record (no system-level record in catalog), MyChart billing.

name: Providence
why: Large multi-state health system (7 states); system-level MyChart billing record.

name: HCA Healthcare
why: Largest U.S. hospital operator (~190 hospitals in 19 states); system-wide HCA ePay bill pay with guest pay, plans and recurring payments.

name: Ascension
why: One of the largest nonprofit/Catholic systems (~100 hospitals); Ascension (VisitPay) online billing account with guest pay and self-serve finance plans.

name: Banner Health
why: Largest system in Arizona and the Mountain West (6 states); single statement paid online with account number and date of birth.

name: Northwell Health
why: New York's largest health system; MyNorthwell (Epic MyChart) bill pay with guest pay, paperless and documented online payment-plan rules.

name: Baylor Scott & White Health
why: Largest nonprofit system in Texas; MyBSWHealth guest pay, paperless and interest-free payment plans plus 24/7 automated phone pay.

name: Sutter Health
why: Major Northern California system; My Health Online (MyChart) bill pay and Guest Pay, credit-card-only online payments.

name: UCLA Health
why: Major academic system in Los Angeles; myUCLAhealth bill pay, automatic paperless enrollment, fee-free 24/7 phone pay.

name: Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center
why: Nationally known cancer center; MSK MyChart bill pay with Pay as Guest, invitation-only enrollment, plans by phone.

name: Hackensack Meridian Health
why: New Jersey's largest health network; MyChart Pay as Guest, 24/7 automated phone pay, interest-free plans by phone.

name: Sharp HealthCare
why: San Diego's largest system; Sharp app (MyChart) bill pay, guest pay by guarantor ID and last name, monthly installment plans.
